createdAt.description: Legacy UTC-day variant. Provide this field alone as an ISO 8601 instant; it is incompatible with date and timeZone.

date.description: Local calendar-day variant. Provide together with timeZone as YYYY-MM-DD; it is incompatible with createdAt. Example: 2026-10-22.

timeZone.description: IANA TZDB timezone (including UTC) for the local calendar-day variant. Provide together with date. Both local midnights must exist, be unambiguous and fit UTC bounds; skipped dates are rejected. Example: Europe/Warsaw.
